question: Which of the following organisations won the Pulitzer Prize for Public Service in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ProPublica**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **ProPublica**, an independent, nonprofit newsroom, won the Pulitzer Prize for Public Service in 2025.
 
• The Pulitzer Prize for Public Service is considered the most prestigious among the Pulitzer categories, awarded for impactful investigative journalism.
 
• ProPublica is known for its focus on stories that expose abuses of power and injustices, often leading to significant reforms.
